title: Loot sword and pig eye
description: Adds a loot-enhancing sword and a Pig Eye that allows a one-time teleport onto the Nether roof.
body:
Loot Sword and Pig Eye adds two new gameplay items with unique mechanics:

• Lootbound Sword  
A netherite-tier sword with a 7% chance to spawn 1–3 bonus drops when killing non-player mobs.  
The bonus loot comes from a balanced custom loot pool and does not replace normal mob drops.

• Pig Eye  
Pigs have a 50% chance to drop a Pig Eye (only once per player).  
Right-clicking the Pig Eye in the Nether near the ceiling teleports the player onto the Nether roof.  
After use, the Pig Eye becomes consumed and cannot be reused.

Features:
✔ Vanilla-friendly mechanics  
✔ Balanced bonus loot  
✔ One-time Nether roof access per player  
✔ Works in singleplayer and multiplayer

Platform:
• Fabric  
• Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.5
